title: Add usage-weighted profile aggregator and changelog primer
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: The model registry currently stores per-variant performance profiles generated from offline probes and onboarding runs. Production telemetry contains valuable, usage-weighted signals (sequence length distribution, typical prompt prefixes, error-rate by bucket) that can materially change recommended performance profiles and changelog framing. This PR introduces a usage-weighted profile aggregator that consumes recent telemetry snapshots to produce aggregated performance profiles and a lightweight changelog primer to aid release authors and SREs.
Solution: 1) ingestion/aggregator: a new microservice component (registry.usage_aggregator) that reads time-windowed telemetry (via existing telemetry export API) and computes weighted aggregates for latency, token-distribution, typical prefix histograms, and cache-hit estimates. 2) profile model: compact JSON schema for aggregated_profile with provenance metadata and sample counts. 3) changelog primer: a template-driven generator that converts diffs between baseline and aggregated profiles into prioritized note suggestions (performance regressions, cost-opportunities, quantization caveats). 4) API: POST /v1/models/:id/aggregates and GET /v1/models/:id/changelog_primer. 5) CLI: regctl model synth-changelog --window 7d to preview suggestions.
Rollout and safety: aggregator runs as opt-in per-model for 7d pilot. Aggregates are stored as read-only snapshots and never used to auto-rollout model variants; they only surface recommendations. Config knobs include sample_window, min_sample_threshold, and retention_days. All telemetry inputs are processed with sampling and PII-scrubbing filters to preserve privacy and compliance.
Testing and validation: added e2e tests that feed synthetic telemetry, unit tests for aggregator math, and regression tests for primer output formatting. Benchmarks show aggregator computes 7-day window aggregates for 5k variants in ~18m on a single m5d. Large-run performance plan documented.
Backward compatibility: API additions are additive. Existing profile formats still accepted. No breaking changes.
Docs and examples: docs/primer.md contains usage examples and prompt seeds for change authors, and examples/telemetry-samples contains sanitized fixtures.
TL;DR: production-safe, opt-in telemetry aggregation that surfaces usage-weighted profile deltas and auto-drafts changelog primer suggestions to improve release quality and reduce manual triage.
commits: core(aggregator): add usage-weighted aggregator and sampling utilities
api: expose aggregated_profile endpoints and changelog primer endpoint
cli: add regctl model synth-changelog command and flags
docs: add primer documentation with examples and rollout guide
tests: telemetry integration tests and unit coverage for aggregator math
ci: add integration job for aggregator against synthetic telemetry dataset
review_comments: Arjun Patel (2026-02-19): Can you add a circuit-breaker if the telemetry export API starts returning 5xx? Also request adding metrics for skipped samples due to PII filter.
Maya Chen (2026-02-19): Added circuit-breaker and metrics.skipped_samples; updated docs to call out PII filter behavior.
Nina Gomez (2026-02-21): The primer output looks good but we should tone down the language for 'regression' and classify by confidence. Please add confidence scores and sample-count thresholds.
Maya Chen (2026-02-21): Added confidence bucket and min_sample_threshold config; updated unit tests. Marking for re-review.
Liam O'Connor (2026-02-23): Security review: checked telemetry scrubbing and storage retention. Suggest adding an integration test for retention enforcement.
Maya Chen (2026-02-24): Added retention enforcement test and updated migrations to set TTL on aggregated_profiles table. CI passing locally.
Nina Gomez (2026-02-25): Approved after verifying confidence scoring and primer phrasing.
release_notes: Added opt-in usage-weighted profile aggregation and changelog primer: a new service and APIs that produce aggregated performance profiles from production telemetry and auto-draft changelog suggestions. Opt-in pilot; configurable retention and sample thresholds. No breaking changes.
notes_for_oncall: Aggregator will surface suggested regressions; it will not auto-rollout. Watch aggregator.job.latency and metrics.skipped_samples during pilot. If telemetry API 5xx spikes, aggregator will backoff and emit alerts.
performance_impact_summary: Aggregation adds a new nightly compute job. Measured cost ~0.12 USD per 1000 variants for a 7-day window on current infra; see docs/primer.md for tuning knobs.
